Sources.PanelHint: Hide sourcebooks you don't own or don't want to see - this only affects your own view, not what your GM has enabled for the table.
Sources.NoneEnabled: Your GM hasn't enabled any sourcebooks yet.

Discard.ButtonTitle: Discard this character and start a new one
Discard.Title: Discard This Character?
Discard.Confirm: This will permanently delete {name} and everything chosen so far. This can't be undone. A brand new, empty character will open right after.

ReplaceItem.Title: Replace This Pick?
ReplaceItem.Warning: Switching from {old} to {incoming} will remove {old} and everything it granted, including:

CustomForm.Hint: Creates a bare placeholder you can finish authoring on its own item sheet afterward (description, proficiencies, advancement, etc.).
CustomForm.Name: Name

Class.Intro: Choose a class to see its features, proficiencies, and choices. You can add more than one class to multiclass, and remove any of them.
Class.NoneAvailable: No classes are available for the selected ruleset and enabled compendiums.
Class.ReviewWarning: This will redo every choice for {name} from level 1 up to level {level}, including ones already made - useful if something was left unanswered earlier. Anything already chosen correctly will need to be picked again.
Class.MaxLevelReached: Character level 20 reached - remove or lower a class to add another.
Class.RemoveWarning: Removing {name} will remove everything it granted, including the following:
Class.LevelDecreaseWarning: Lowering to level {level} will remove the following, granted at levels above it:
Class.LevelDecreaseAbilityWarning: An Ability Score Improvement from one of those levels will also be undone.

Feats.Intro: Feats granted by your class, species, or background show up here. If a source grants a specific origin feat, you can swap it for a different one.
Feats.NoneYet: No feats yet. Feats granted by your background, species, or a higher starting level will appear here.

Skills.Intro: Every skill proficiency granted so far, from your class, species, background, and feats, is aggregated here. Skill choices themselves are made where they're granted, not on this step.

Spells.Intro: Pick your class's cantrips and known spells here. Spells granted by a feat or background (like Magic Initiate) are already resolved and just shown for reference.
Spells.NoSpellcasting: This character has no spellcasting yet. Pick a spellcasting class to see cantrip and spell choices here.

Duplicate.Title: Already Known
Duplicate.Warning: {name} is already granted by {source}. Duplicate spells and proficiencies generally don't stack, so picking it again won't give any extra benefit - add it anyway?

Equipment.Intro: Choose your class's and background's starting equipment kit, or clear a source and pick a different one. You can also add items of your own directly.
Equipment.WealthOption: Take {amount} GP instead, and buy your own equipment
Equipment.AddItemHint: Priced items are bought with your real currency ({available} available); unpriced items are still free to add.
Equipment.BudgetHint: Currency only comes from your class/background starting kit or the "take gold instead" option - there's no other source at creation, so a first-level character can't overspend on gear no matter what's added here.
Equipment.CannotAfford: You can't afford {item} ({price}) - you only have {available}.
Equipment.NoneYet: No equipment yet. Pick a starting kit above, or add your own items.

Species.Intro: Choose a species to see its traits and choices. You can change your mind and pick a different species before moving on.
Species.NoneAvailable: No species are available for the selected ruleset and enabled compendiums.

Background.Intro: Choose a background to see its proficiencies and choices. You can change your mind and pick a different background before moving on.
Background.NoneAvailable: No backgrounds are available for the selected ruleset and enabled compendiums.

Abilities.Intro: Choose how to generate your ability scores. Any Ability Score Improvement already granted by your background, species, or class shows up as a separate bonus on top, so it never gets overwritten.
Abilities.StandardArrayHint: Assign the fixed set 15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8 to your six abilities.
Abilities.PointBuyHint: Spend a 27-point budget to buy scores between 8 and 15.
Abilities.RollHint: Roll 4d6 (drop the lowest) six times and assign the results.
Abilities.Incomplete: Assign a value to every ability score before continuing.

Ruleset.Title: Choose a ruleset
Ruleset.Description: Create a character using the 2014 (D&D 5e) rules, the 2024 (D&D 5.5e) rules, or both at once. This determines which races, classes, backgrounds, and features are offered in later steps.
Ruleset.2024Hint: The updated rules from the 2024 core rulebooks.
Ruleset.BothHint: Show content from both the 2014 and 2024 rules side by side.

About.Intro: Fill in your character's personality, appearance, and background. None of this affects game mechanics, except Lifestyle, which is a reference for downtime upkeep costs.

Review.Intro: Review every choice before building your character. You can still go back to any earlier step to make changes.
Review.ExportPopupBlocked: Your browser blocked the export tab. Please allow popups for this site and try again.
Review.FinalizeConfirm: This will finish creating {name} and add them to your Actor Directory. You can still edit the character afterward from its sheet.
Review.SubmitReviewConfirm: This will send {name} to your GM for approval. You'll be notified once it's approved and added to the Actor Directory.
Review.PendingReviewBanner: Submitted - awaiting GM review before this character is finalized.
Review.PendingReviewMessage: {player} has finished building {name} and it's awaiting your review.

Placeholder.Text: This step is still in development. Tell us how it should work and we'll build it out.

DefaultRuleset.Name: Default ruleset
DefaultRuleset.Hint: Which ruleset (2014 or 2024) to default to in the character creation wizard.

RequireGmReview.Name: Require GM review before finalizing
RequireGmReview.Hint: When enabled, a player's "Build Character" submits the finished character for GM approval instead of finalizing it directly. The GM approves it from a whispered chat card. Off by default - GMs themselves are never gated by this.

CompendiumSources.MenuHint: Choose which compendiums the character creator wizard is allowed to pull races, classes, backgrounds, and other content from, and optionally tag each one as 2014 or 2024 content.
CompendiumSources.Title: Compendium Sources
CompendiumSources.Intro: Select which compendiums players can draw content from, and optionally tag each one with a ruleset. Packs left on "Auto" use the ruleset stored on each item when available, and are otherwise treated as available for any ruleset.

HouseRules.MenuHint: Restrict how characters can be built in the character creator wizard: which ability score methods are offered, which alignments are allowed, the minimum level feats become available, and any banned species.
HouseRules.Title: House Rules
HouseRules.Intro: These restrict how a character can be built, on top of whatever content the Compendium Sources settings already allow.
HouseRules.AbilityMethodsHint: Which generation methods players can choose from on the Ability Scores step.
HouseRules.DisallowedAlignmentsHint: Checked alignments won't be offered on the About step. None disallowed by default.
HouseRules.MinFeatLevelHint: The level a character needs to reach before an origin feat can be swapped on the Feats step. Set to 0 to disable feat swapping entirely.
HouseRules.BannedSpeciesHint: Checked species won't be offered on the Species step, regardless of ruleset.

ClassExtras.PartyAdvisorComplete: Your party already covers every role.
ClassExtras.PartyAdvisorNoParty: Set a primary party (in the Actor Directory) to get role-coverage suggestions here.
